listing.name: Draconis Fleet (WIP) - 0.7.9
listing.summary: Adds a new faction with a militarized government, fast and lightly armored ships, and a lore-driven backstory centered on survival and retaliation.

description:
Quote

"Yesterday, without warning, without grievance beyond their own manufactured envy, Athebyne struck our people in the dark. I will not stand before you and call this war - I will call it what it is: murder dressed in a flag. But I will tell you this, and I will mean every word: we will answer this butchery with everything Itoron has ever built, and we will answer it until no convoy, no worker, no citizen of this world need ever again look to the stars and wonder if today is the day they burn."
— Director-General Samuel J. Harrows, address to the Combined Legislature, c176

// Overview:

The Draconis Defence Alliance is a stratocracy governing the Fafnir system - a state of emergency declared at the end of a brutal civil war and never rescinded. Fleet Admiral Emil August, who shattered the rebel world of Athebyne with seventy-two hours of orbital bombardment, has ruled by consolidated military authority ever since. The Alliance's independence is maintained through geographic isolation, a doctrine of total resistance, and arrangements with outside powers that neither party publicly acknowledges.

Draconis hulls are built around a consistent philosophy: flux capacity and speed over armour and shields. Doctrine assumes no reinforcement and no safe fallback position, so engagements are designed around rapid strikes with concentrated firepower followed by disengagement before combat readiness collapses. The ships excel in this role but struggle outside of it - catch one in a sustained engagement, and the thin protection quickly becomes a liability. Ballistics and missiles are the weapons of choice; the fleet is not built for prolonged flux wars.

Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib and MagicLib

Supports: Nexerelin, Combat Chatter, AdvancedGunneryControl and Commissioned Crews

Known Issues:

None, yet...

// History:

Fafnir was a Domain backwater colony that the Collapse simply forgot - remote enough to escape the worst of it, isolated enough that no one came to help after. Two worlds turned inward, repurposing what the Domain left behind into rival governments that eventually ran out of patience with each other.

The war was brutal, and the peace that followed barely qualifies as one. Athebyne burned, and the Alliance that rose from the aftermath is held together by military governance, mutual dependence, and the quiet understanding that neither world survives without the other. Their infrastructure is gutted, and their continued independence puzzles outside observers more than it impresses them.

They use what works - improvised solutions, captured technology, and systems other factions consider forbidden. In Fafnir, that's just called procurement.

aiDescription: Adds a new faction to the game called the Draconis Defence Alliance, a militarized government ruling the Fafnir system after a brutal civil war. The faction features a fleet of fast, lightly armored ships optimized for hit-and-run tactics using ballistic and missile weapons. It includes unique ship designs, lore, and support for several other mods.
